name: dialog-flow
script: await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/dialog-page'); try { await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Go' }).click(); } catch (e) { } const d = await page.waitForEvent('dialog', { timeoutMs: 8000 }); const m = d.message; await d.accept(); await page.waitForTimeout(300); return m
